mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CART_ITEMS (CART_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_OPTION_ID, QUANTITY, SOURCE_LISTING_ID) VALUES (#{cartId}, #{productId}, #{productOptionId}, #{quantity}, #{sourceListingId})
mapper.select: SELECT CART_ID FROM CARTS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT CART_ID FROM CART_ITEMS WHERE CART_ITEM_ID = #{cartItemId}

SELECT CI.CART_ITEM_ID, P.PRODUCT_ID, P.NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, P.BRAND, P.SALE_PRICE, P.SHIPPING_FEE, P.STOCK, (SELECT PI.S3_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID ORDER BY PI.IS_COVER DESC, PI.SORT_ORDER ASC LIMIT 1) AS COVER_IMAGE_URL, PO.PRODUCT_OPTION_ID, PO.OPTION_TYPE, PO.OPTION_VALUE, PO.ADDITIONAL_PRICE, CI.QUANTITY, CI.SOURCE_LISTING_ID, L.TITLE AS SOURCE_LISTING_TITLE FROM CART_ITEMS CI JOIN PRODUCTS P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = CI.PRODUCT_ID AND P.DELETED_AT IS NULL LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTIONS PO ON PO.PRODUCT_OPTION_ID = CI.PRODUCT_OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN LISTINGS L ON L.LISTING_ID = CI.SOURCE_LISTING_ID AND L.DELETED_AT IS NULL WHERE CI.CART_ID = #{cartId} ORDER BY CI.ADDED_AT DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CART_ITEMS WHERE CART_ID = #{cartId}
mapper.update: UPDATE CART_ITEMS SET QUANTITY = #{quantity} WHERE CART_ITEM_ID = #{cartItemId}
